name: pollution_read_error
description: Test 25, FreeCity4 [choice] of 6 (spec answer PO3): a version-4 record truncated inside the incinerator list makes Read return false; no grid, list or department of the reading simulator is replaced, loaded stays clear, and the references taken during the call are released. Record by hand (layout of 6, as p11_22, 16 x 16 cells, 64-entry table; the intact record first reads back with both incinerators): water-treatment count 0 at 74, incinerator count 2 at 78, its refs at 82 and 90 (8 bytes each), 504 bytes in all; deleting bytes 90..504 cuts the record at the second incinerator ref. Reading into an initialized simulator (one water-treatment plant, air value 7 at tract (1, 1)): false, the plant list, the grids (air value still 7), the department and every scalar stay; inc1, resolved before the failure, gets its reference back (3 before and after: the test's own, the first simulator's and the one handed to the simulator that read the intact record). A fresh simulator that fails the same read stays unloaded, and its Init runs the new-city path: all eight grids and a department are created. Read is called directly (pollution_read) because the store ignores its result (foundations 3.5).
